module: Flowgraph node "Get Drag Racer Status" (category repeat_instant). Gives the state of a driver (vehId pin): isPlayable, lane, isDesqualified, desqualifiedReason, isFinished. When data is missing, the used outputs are false, 0 or empty string.

work.desc: Reads dragBridge.getData and getRacerData(vehId) then writes the used pins.
